title: Si pudiera… y la contracción I'd
goal: a hacer preguntas imaginarias, a distinguir el primer y el segundo condicional y a pronunciar I'd

ex.t: Would you move abroad if you were younger?
ex.es: ¿Te irías a vivir al extranjero si fueras más joven?

ex.t: If I lived by the sea, I'd go sailing every weekend.
ex.es: Si viviera junto al mar, saldría a navegar cada fin de semana.

ex.t: If I had more free time, I'd volunteer at the library.
ex.es: Si tuviera más tiempo libre, haría voluntariado en la biblioteca.

ex.t: What would you do with more free time?
If I could start again, I'd open a café.
ex.es: Si pudiera empezar de nuevo, abriría una cafetería.

ex.t: If I were famous, I'd hate the photographers.
ex.es: Si fuera famosa, odiaría a los fotógrafos.

ex.t: I feel very lucky with my family.
ex.es: Me siento muy afortunada con mi familia.

ex.t: If you could choose any country, which would you choose?
ex.es: Si pudieras elegir cualquier país, ¿cuál elegirías?

pron.title: La contracción I'd
pron.tip: I'd suena «aid»: la d es muy corta y casi se pega al verbo siguiente («aidlaik»). Escucha la diferencia entre I'd go (iría) e I go (voy).

exercises.why: En I'd go se oye una d muy corta antes de go.

exercises.q: If you could choose any country, which ___ you choose?
exercises.why: Pregunta imaginaria: which would you choose?

exercises.q: If it's sunny tomorrow, we ___ go to the beach.
exercises.why: Mañana puede hacer sol de verdad: primer condicional (will).

exercises.q: If I ___ twenty again, I'd move abroad.
exercises.why: No tienes veinte años: imaginario, If I were.

exercises.q: If my grandson ___ his homework, he can play later.
exercises.why: Es real y posible (con can): primer condicional, presente.

exercises.q: If I ___ start again, I'd open a café.
___ you move abroad if you were younger?
If she had more free time, she ___ at the hospital.
exercises.why: Would + volunteer (igual para todas las personas).

exercises.q: You would go sailing in Auckland.
answer: Would you go sailing in Auckland?

exercises.q: If I were famous, I'd hate it.
answer: If I were famous, I would hate it.

exercises.q: If she were here, she'll know what to do.
exercises.why: Imaginario (no está aquí): she'd = she would.

exercises.answer: What would you do with more free time

exercises.q: If I could choose, I'd live by the sea.
answer: Si pudiera elegir, viviría junto al mar.
Si pudiese elegir, viviría junto al mar.
Si pudiera elegir, viviría al lado del mar.

exercises.title: Encuesta en una revista
exercises.text: We asked our readers: what would you do if you had a year off? Most people said they'd travel. Many said they'd volunteer. One reader wrote: 'I'd open a little café by the sea and bake cakes all day.'

exercises.es: Si pudiera elegir cualquier país, elegiría Nueva Zelanda.

dialog.title: El juego de las preguntas
dialog.setting: Yolanda juega con su nieto a hacerse preguntas imaginarias en el coche

lines.t: Grandma, if you could fly, where would you go?
I'd fly to New Zealand. It's so far by plane!
lines.es: Volaría a Nueva Zelanda. ¡Está tan lejos en avión!

lines.t: And if you were famous, what would you be?
A famous cook, of course! And you?
I'd be a footballer. If I were rich, I'd buy you a café.
lines.es: Yo sería futbolista. Si fuera rico, te compraría una cafetería.

lines.t: How lovely! I'd bake cakes for everyone.
lines.es: ¡Qué bonito! Haría tartas para todo el mundo.

lines.t: If we finish the game, can we have ice cream?
lines.es: Si terminamos el juego, ¿podemos tomar un helado?

lines.t: If you're good, we'll stop for one. Deal!
lines.es: Si te portas bien, paramos a tomar uno. ¡Trato hecho!

questions.q: ¿Qué pasará si el nieto se porta bien?

realLife.t: I'd love to, but I can't.
realLife.context: Para rechazar con cariño una invitación

summary: Preguntas imaginarias: What would you do if…? Where would you go if…?
Can → could: If I could choose, I'd…
Real y posible → If + presente, will · Imaginario → If + pasado, would
I'd suena «aid»: I'd go (iría) ≠ I go (voy)
